assumptions.statement: The replacement brand can be selected without preserving the current Gridelyx-derived public terminology.
assumptions.validation_route: Select a replacement brand, inventory persistent protocol/data identifiers, then determine which identifiers can be renamed immediately and which require migration aliases.
assumptions.impact_if_false: Some existing identifiers may require compatibility aliases or staged migration rather than immediate deletion.

assumptions.statement: A web/GitHub collision screen can identify obvious existing uses but cannot prove trademark, company-name, domain or worldwide legal availability.
assumptions.validation_route: For the final candidate, perform jurisdiction-appropriate trademark/business/domain clearance before commercial release.
assumptions.impact_if_false: A name considered clear from ordinary search could still conflict legally or commercially.
